name: status-band
description: The Awesome Statusline layout in a Status tab of the side pane, its bars upright, or as a band by the prompt: model, git, context, 5H/7D limits and Codex 7D

tab.title: Status tab
tab.description: Show the status in a tab of the side pane; the band only where that tab cannot show

size.title: Size
size.description: How much the band shows, from two compact rows to six full ones

animate.title: Animate bars
animate.description: Sweep a glint across the bars when a reading changes and while Claude works

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the band stands: above the prompt, or below it under Claude Code's own mode line

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: The creature under the list of sessions: it sleeps while idle, walks while Claude works, hops when a turn ends and stands under a ? while a prompt waits for you; the crab is Clawd, who digs into sand to sleep and lies on his back once the 5H limit is spent
